title: AAOIFI Stage 1 Pilot Hard-Set Item
description: Schema only. Hard-set content is authored privately by the researcher and must be grounded in the received source corpus.

item_id.description: Unique, stable identifier assigned by the human author.

question_text.description: Human-authored question grounded in the private source corpus.

standard_ids.description: AAOIFI standards referenced by the item.

gold_clause_ids.description: One or more source-faithful, unambiguous clause references supporting the item.

clause_id.description: Clause identifier exactly as extracted from the source.

occurrence_index.description: Source-faithful duplicate-clause disambiguator; use 0 where the identifier occurs once.

sub_clause_id.description: Optional source sub-clause identifier when the supporting record is a sub-clause.

answerability.description: Human judgment about whether the supplied source basis supports a direct answer.

expected_behavior.description: Expected system behavior for this item; this is not a Shari'ah ruling.

gold_answer.description: Human-authored, corpus-grounded answer. Must cite actual clause text; paraphrase from memory is not acceptable.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the item. 'reviewed' means corpus cross-reference complete; 'scholar_validated' means additionally reviewed by a qualified Shari'ah scholar.

verification_basis.description: How the gold_clause_ids and gold_answer have been verified. corpus_cross_reference is NOT equivalent to qualified_scholar_review — these must never be conflated.

notes.description: Human-authored rationale for inclusion, scope, and anticipated difficulty.
